REST-API

  • Entry-Points: Common
    • Ping - /api/agv/common/ping
    • Identify - /api/agv/common/identify
    • Restart - /api/agv/common/restart
  • Entry-Points: Buzzer
    • Buzzer Off - /api/agv/buzzer/off
    • Buzzer On - /api/agv/buzzer/on
    • Beep Once - /api/agv/buzzer/beepOnce
    • Beep Infinite - /api/agv/buzzer/beepInfinite
    • Beep N-times - /api/agv/buzzer/beepNTimes
  • Entry-Points: I2C Scanner
    • I2C Device Scanner - /api/agv/i2c/scan
  • Entry-Points: Info
    • AGV Info – /api/info/agv
    • ESP32 Chip Info – /api/info/esp32/chip
    • ESP32 Network Info – /api/info/esp32/network
    • ESP32 Partition Info – /api/info/esp32/partitions
    • ESP32 Tasks Information – /api/info/esp32/tasks
  • Entry-Points: Stepper
    • Set Velocity (beide) – /api/agv/stepper/setVelocity
    • Enable/Disable – /api/agv/stepper/enable
    • Is Moving – /api/agv/stepper/isMoving
    • Motion Mode – /api/agv/stepper/motionMode
    • Abort Motion – /api/agv/stepper/abortMotion
    • Reset Position – /api/agv/stepper/resetPosition
    • Get Current Velocity – /api/agv/stepper/getCurrentVelocity
    • Get Current Position – /api/agv/stepper/getCurrentPosition
    • Set Velocity (einzeln) – /api/agv/stepper/setVelocitySingle
    • Set Max Velocity % – /api/agv/stepper/setMaxVelocityPerc
    • Set Max Acceleration % – /api/agv/stepper/setMaxAccelerationPerc
    • Move Absolute – /api/agv/stepper/setMoveAbsolute
    • Move Relative – /api/agv/stepper/setMoveRelative
  • Entry-Points: PWM
    • PWM Settings – /api/agv/pwm/settings
    • PWM Enable – /api/agv/pwm/enable
    • Set Active Servos – /api/agv/pwm/setActiveServos
    • Set Channel Position – /api/agv/pwm/channel/setPosition
    • Set Channel Limits – /api/agv/pwm/channel/setLimits
    • Set Channel Start Position – /api/agv/pwm/channel/setStartPosition
    • Set Channel Full Sweep Time – /api/agv/pwm/channel/setFullSweepTime
  • Entry-Points: LED
    • LED Off – /api/agv/led/off
    • LED On – /api/agv/led/on
    • LED Flash Once – /api/agv/led/flashOnce
    • LED Flash Infinite – /api/agv/led/flashInfinite
    • LED Flash N-times – /api/agv/led/flashNTimes
  • Entry-Points: WiFi
    • WiFi Settings – /api/agv/wifi/getWifiSettings
    • Set Active WiFi Mode – /api/agv/wifi/setActiveMode
    • Set WiFi Mode Data – /api/agv/wifi/setModeData
  • Entry-Points: WhereIsMyAGV
    • WhereIsMyAGV Status – /api/agv/whereIsMyAGV/status
    • WhereIsMyAGV Enable – /api/agv/whereIsMyAGV/enable
    • WhereIsMyAGV Settings – /api/agv/whereIsMyAGV/settings
  • Entry-Points: NVS (Non-Volatile Storage)
    • List NVS Namespaces – /api/nve/namespaces
    • List Keys and Values – /api/nve/listKeysAndValues
  • Entry-Points: Line Follower
    • Line Follower Sensors – /api/agv/linefollower/settings
    • Line Follower Info – /api/agv/linefollower/info
    • Line Follower Sensors – /api/agv/linefollower/sensors
    • Line Follower Sensors – /api/agv/linefollower/enable
    • Set Sample Delta Time – /api/agv/linefollower/setSampleDeltaTime
  • Entry-Points: ToF Sensor
    • ToF Distance - /api/agv/tof/distance
    • ToF Enable Status - /api/agv/tof/enable
    • ToF Enable Set - /api/agv/tof/enable
    • ToF Info - /api/agv/tof/info
